Behavior:
    - a_dir / b_dir select the direction on that side: 1 means write, 0 means read.
    - Accepted writes must appear in order on the opposite side when that side reads.
    - Full/empty and almost-full/almost-empty flags are local to each side.

    - FALLTHROUGH does not select a combinational read. Each side's read data is one local sample taken while that side is the reader. Pointers in both directions cross as acknowledged binary snapshots, so full and empty can lag.
